spellbook.finance/limitations: This removes a real marketplace offer. It does not mark the physical units opened or held.
A preview with external_listing_requires_takeover names an offer SpellBook does not manage. This tool cannot remove that offer.
A pending state means removal was requested but live absence was not confirmed. Preview again after the paired TCGplayer extension or ManaPool readback finishes.

description: Remove one SpellBook-managed sealed listing from ManaPool or set its TCGplayer quantity to zero through the paired browser. Call spellbook_sealed_listing_preview first and pass its channel and intentRevision unchanged. A product with no saved SpellBook intent cannot be removed by this tool.

boxId.description: The exact TCGplayer sealed product id from the portfolio row. Required.

channel.description: Marketplace whose managed listing should be removed. Defaults to manapool.

expectedIntentRevision.description: The non-null intentRevision from a fresh spellbook_sealed_listing_preview. Required.

game.description: The product game. Defaults to mtg.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique request key for this removal, such as a new UUID. If the result is uncertain, preview current state before deciding on another pause. Required.

kind.description: The sealed kind from the same portfolio row. Required.

language.description: The product language code. Defaults to EN.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the listing. Required.

name: spellbook_sealed_listing_pause
